span.p:
keepalive 32 = reuse nginx→backend connections.
Without it, every request pays a handshake
and you measure TCP, not load balancing.
proxy_set_header Connection "" is required —
otherwise the backend closes the connection.

span.p:
No admin_pool here.
The stream module has no location block,
so there is no way to route /admin/*
somewhere else. That is the capability gap.
